scenarios.title: Join the GSV ticket board
scenarios.body: Open tickets are the board for people who want to join. Claim via Galaxy or MCP gsv_tickets_claim.

scenarios.title: Drain next PH-S* band
scenarios.body: абракадабра / abrakadabra: products scan → S0 disk → warnings-first → one commit + push.

scenarios.title: Squad development ticket
scenarios.body: Assign to a random online MCP (squad). Solo mode uses the single MCP instead.

scenarios.title: Solo bot: Telegram ticket
scenarios.body: Ingest a Godfather /ticket message as a board row. The one online MCP claims it (tickets.mode=solo).

scenarios.title: PoolAI cargo test-ci
scenarios.body: Registered product poolai: run cargo test-ci with CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/s/rust/poolAI/target.

scenarios.title: Light Rust MDS app
scenarios.body: Solo bot walks this band: scaffold gsv-mds, memory probe, disk probe, speed probe, JSON wire + tests, Telegram sync on claim/done.

tickets.title: MDS: scaffold bin
tickets.body: Add boxes/mds.rs and src/bin/gsv_mds.rs. cargo run --bin gsv-mds.

tickets.title: MDS: memory probe
tickets.body: 1 MiB alloc sample plus OS phys (GlobalMemoryStatusEx on Windows).

tickets.title: MDS: JSON wire + tests
tickets.body: GET /api/mds, MCP gsv_mds, gsv_mds_contracts, cargo test.

tickets.title: MDS: solo walk Telegram sync
tickets.body: Claim/done each row; enqueue kind:sync envelopes. POST /api/tickets/walk.

scenarios.title: Abrakadabra session walk
scenarios.body: MCP bot narrates an abrakadabra-shaped drain on Godfather: S0, warnings-first, solo MDS, squad assign, gsv_dev bench, close. Live sendMessage 1/s; tests dry-run.

tickets.title: Session: S0 disk
tickets.body: solo: df /s and cargo xtask disk. Post free GiB on Godfather.

tickets.title: Session: warnings-first
tickets.body: solo: cargo clippy --all-targets. Post warning count (0 is ok).

tickets.title: Session: solo MDS walk
tickets.body: solo: create memory-disk-speed band if needed; walk claim/done; post each step.

tickets.title: Session: squad assign
tickets.body: squad: heartbeat two workers in tests; live may be one MCP. Post assigned to {worker}.

tickets.title: Session: gsv_dev bench
tickets.body: bench: scenario_band_create / solo_walk_mds / mds_report / telegram_enqueue_sync. Post medians.

tickets.title: Session: close
tickets.body: solo: fmt/clippy/test/loc-audit line, then bump+fingerprint in the real drain close.

scenarios.title: Hook tickets from roadmap or plan
scenarios.body: run mcp bot hook up scenario <id|band N|plan stem> [walk]. Parses GSV_TECH_ROADMAP.md PH-S* rows or superpowers plan checkboxes into ≤10 board rows. MCP gsv_tickets_hook.

scenarios.title: Join a squad with your own GSV jail
scenarios.body: Install gsv-server locally. Wire folder MCP to http://127.0.0.1:9999/mcp (never User MCP, never a remote /mcp). Join the host Godfather channel as a human. Heartbeat gsv_tickets_presence. Do not paste the Telegram token. Shared host bot uses from=jail_id; optional own bot consumes a Telegram admin slot.

scenarios.title: Host your own Godfather channel
scenarios.body: Create a Telegram channel, add a BotFather bot as admin, invite humans. Squad MCP cap = member_count. BotFather bot slots = 50 channel admins or 20 group bots. Extra jails share this bot via from=jail_id. GitHub Flow: branch per ticket, sequential PR merge.

scenarios.title: Build an app inside the GSV jail
scenarios.body: Solo or squad: product code stays in this crate sandbox (preview confine, SLI allowlist, no User MCP). Git: solo = one commit on main at drain close; squad = one worktree/branch per jail, sequential merge. Ticket board is A2A; git is the merge queue.

scenarios.title: Hook open GitHub issues onto the board
scenarios.body: run mcp bot hook up scenario github. Imports origin open issues as GH#N rows (idempotent). Next-action picks the local board first, then GitHub. Installer update: gsv_update github_ahead when origin is newer than this crate even if src/ is not.

scenarios.title: Host: you admin the Godfather channel
scenarios.body: Bot is channel/group administrator. Bind token, poll, hook GitHub, run squad. getChatMember → host. Extra jails share this bot via from=jail_id.

scenarios.title: Mate: you are a channel member
scenarios.body: Join the host channel as a human. Wire YOUR loopback MCP. Heartbeat presence. Claim tickets. Do not paste the host Telegram secret. Optional own bot consumes a Telegram admin slot. Settings role=mate.

scenarios.title: Guest: not a channel member yet
scenarios.body: Solo on this jail until you join the Godfather chat. Ticket-squad is ignored. Live bus send is refused. GitHub origin update still applies if the installer is behind. Settings role=guest.

scenarios.title: Ranks: jun-nub to marshal-orchestrator
scenarios.body: Merit ladder L0 jun-nub through L15 marshal-orchestrator (IT + army mix). Host of the Godfather channel displays marshal-orchestrator. Done tickets raise a rank; ticket error or cargo test fail after commit drops one. Floor is 0. Telegram from.id is redacted to a tail. Store data/gsv_ranks.json.

scenarios.title: Federated presence: remote jails on the host board
scenarios.body: Mate/host jails heartbeat kind:presence on Godfather (from=jail.id). Host Galaxy shows federation rows. Remote workers do not consume this jail squad_cap and cannot claim this jail tickets.jsonl. Guest stays solo and does not post presence. Echo of this jail is ignored.
